title: 安妮·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 小女孩留着红色短发，深色尖角头饰呼应棕色泰迪熊。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Annie is a little girl with a short red bob, a dark headband with small pointed decorations, large curious eyes, and her brown teddy bear Tibbers. Preserve her child age and small natural child proportions, never an adult figure. Dress her in a modest long-sleeved purple dress, opaque tights, sturdy boots, and a short cape; Tibbers remains an ordinary plush bear.
art_direction.scene: A low viewpoint with a calm upward head turn, full iconic shape framed by a simple sweep of bright pencil hatching. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: berry purple, ginger red, teddy brown, amber rim light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
